about: P0 reference for accept.p05.determinism: trace and end-of-run snapshot of the P0 acceptance scenarios (sim.two-pcs-switch: seed 7, 40 s, ping 10.0.0.2 from pc1, runToIdle; sim.pc-router-pc: seed 3, 60 s, ping 10.0.1.1 from pc1, runToIdle) as produced by the P0 engine before the P0.5 build. Port MACs are replaced by mac<device/port> tokens, FcsRecompute values by "fcs" and RouteRow.owner is left out of table rows (test/accept.p05.harness.ts); events are "<t>|<kind>|<sha-256 prefix of the canonical normalised event>".
